title: Alternating Cech total complex of a quasi-coherent complex computes derived sections
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a finite open covering $\mathcal U:U=\bigcup_{i=1}^rU_i$ such that $U_{i_0\ldots i_p}=U_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{i_p}$ is affine for all $p\ge0$ and all $i_0,\ldots,i_p$. Let $\mathcal F^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], not assumed bounded in either direction. Let $\operatorname{Tot}(\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet_{\mathrm{alt}}(\mathcal U,\mathcal F^\bullet))$ be the total complex of the double complex with terms $\check{\mathcal C}^p_{\mathrm{alt}}(\mathcal U,\mathcal F^q)=\prod_{i_0<\cdots<i_p}\mathcal F^q(U_{i_0\ldots i_p})$, the alternating Cech differential $d_1$ [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] in the $p$-direction, the differential $d_2$ induced by $\mathcal F^\bullet$ in the $q$-direction, and total differential $d_1+(-1)^pd_2$ on the $(p,q)$ term. Then there is a canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{Tot}(\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet_{\mathrm{alt}}(\mathcal U,\mathcal F^\bullet))\to R\Gamma(U,\mathcal F^\bullet)$ in $D(\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U))$ [def-pc-derived-category] [def-pc-derived-direct-image], functorial in $\mathcal F^\bullet$.
